meta.title: The falsification register
meta.note: One entry for every curated claim on this site that a reader could settle on their own: what is claimed, what it rests on, how many independent classes of source stand behind it, which adversary switch would remove it, and the evidence that would decide it. The register is generated from the provenance graph, so an entry cannot go missing by being forgotten.
meta.label: challenge

conditions.title: A load-bearing figure shown to be wrong
conditions.detail: from a source of equal or better standing. Casualty figures, settlement counts, detention numbers and destruction totals are attributed to the body that recorded them, with the date of the record, precisely so that a superseding figure can be identified and substituted.

conditions.title: A quotation shown to be fabricated, mistranslated or materially decontextualised
conditions.detail: Every statement carries a named speaker, a role, a date and a source; where a widely circulated paraphrase differs from the sourced verbatim wording, both are recorded and the difference is stated; a weakly sourced item carries that caveat inline rather than being quietly retained.

conditions.title: A finding withdrawn or reversed by the body that issued it
conditions.detail: The findings relied on here are institutional, not anonymous, and each is therefore capable of being retracted by an identifiable author.

conditions.title: The ICJ’s merits judgment in South Africa v. Israel
conditions.detail: which is the one authority that could displace rather than merely dispute the central legal characterisation, and which this record expressly does not pre-empt. It is not in the register below because no entry can anticipate it: it is the one test this record cannot run on itself.

kinds.label: Figures
kinds.note: A number attributed to the body that recorded it, on the date it recorded it.
kinds.test: Produce a figure for the same quantity, at the same date or later, from a body of equal or better standing than the one named here. The figure on this page is then superseded and replaced, and the change is published in the revision history.

kinds.label: Statements
kinds.note: Something a named person or body said, on a named date, in a named place.
kinds.test: Produce the recording, transcript or original publication showing that the words were not said, that the translation is wrong, or that the surrounding text changes their meaning. The entry is then withdrawn or corrected on its face, and the correction is published rather than made silently.

kinds.label: Findings and records
kinds.note: A finding, a ruling or a documented fact carried from an identified body.
kinds.test: Show that the body named has withdrawn, corrected or reversed the finding, or produce a record of equal standing that contradicts it. A finding retracted by its own author is removed here; a finding merely disputed is kept with the dispute recorded beside it.

switches.label: Remove every Palestinian source
switches.note: The commonest objection to this record is that the casualty figures come from the Gaza Ministry of Health. This removes the ministry, the Palestinian Central Bureau of Statistics, WAFA and every Palestinian human rights organisation.

switches.label: Remove every Israeli source
switches.note: The mirror objection, that Israeli critics of the state are unrepresentative. This removes B'Tselem, Yesh Din, Breaking the Silence, Haaretz, the Israeli courts and the military’s own statements.

switches.label: Remove the United Nations
switches.note: The objection that UN bodies are institutionally hostile. This removes OCHA, UNRWA, the WHO, the Commission of Inquiry, the Special Rapporteurs and the IPC.

switches.label: Remove every human rights organisation
switches.note: The objection that the NGO sector campaigns rather than reports. This removes Amnesty, Human Rights Watch and every organisation of that kind on any side.

switches.label: Keep only Israeli and Western sources
switches.note: The hardest test the record can be put to: nothing Palestinian, nothing from the UN, nothing from an NGO. What is left is the Israeli state, the Israeli press, Israeli human rights organisations, Western states, Western courts, Western universities and the Western press.
